essence: The external structural load must be increased so that it ends at the prescribed portion measures.
The dimensions are to be set according to the stated numerical and elemental quality measures.
The construction must include the base, lotus, fillets, corner member, and kapaka in sequence.
The members are proportioned using quarter-less, half, three-part, and two-part measures.
The entry and exit of these elements should be arranged according to their beauty and strength.
